articles.abstract_en: Modern mutual fund families include more than active mutual funds (AMFs). AMFs in families with greater index mutual fund (IMF) presence generate higher category-adjusted gross returns. Performance is positively related to the levels of passive and active fees, suggesting moral hazard. Intrafamily competition from IMFs in the same Morningstar category incentivizes managers to exert effort. Financial resources do not contribute to the performance effect. Cross-trading with IMFs occurs with some positive effect on performance. ETFs have no impact on performance. IMFs reduce flow-performance sensitivity and flow volatility of AMFs in the family. IMFs and ETFs uniquely contribute to expense pressure.
articles.abstract_cn: 现代共同基金家族包含的不仅仅是主动管理型共同基金（AMFs）。在指数共同基金（IMFs）存在度更高的家族中，AMFs能产生更高的类别调整后总回报。业绩与被动和主动费用水平正相关，这表明存在道德风险。同一晨星类别中来自IMFs的家族内竞争激励基金经理付出努力。财务资源对业绩效应没有贡献。与IMFs的交叉交易对业绩有一些正面影响。交易所交易基金（ETFs）对业绩没有影响。IMFs降低了家族中AMFs的资金流动-业绩敏感性和资金流动波动性。IMFs和ETFs对费用压力有独特贡献。

articles.title_en: The global factor structure of exchange rates
articles.abstract_en: We propose a model-free methodology to estimate international stochastic discount factors (SDFs) that jointly price cross-sections of international stocks, bonds, and currencies in markets with frictions. We theoretically establish a SDF decomposition into one global factor and a currency basket. We show that our global factor prices a large cross-section of international asset returns, not just in- but also out-of-sample, across different currency denominations. Moreover, the pricing ability of the global factor is largely independent of the market structure or the size and type of market friction.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种无模型方法，用于估计国际随机贴现因子（SDFs），这些因子在存在摩擦的市场中共同为国际股票、债券和货币的横截面定价。我们在理论上建立了SDF分解为一个全球因子和一个货币篮子。我们表明，我们的全球因子为国际资产收益的大横截面定价，不仅在样本内，而且在样本外，跨不同货币计价。此外，全球因子的定价能力在很大程度上独立于市场结构或市场摩擦的大小和类型。

articles.title_en: Set it and forget it? Financing retirement in an age of defaults
articles.title_cn: 设置后就不管了？在默认选择的时代为退休融资
articles.abstract_en: Retirement savings abandonment is a rising concern connected to defined contribution systems and default enrollment. We use tax data on Individual Retirement Accounts (IRAs) to establish that for a recent cohort, 0.4% of retirement-age individuals abandoned an aggregate of $66 million, proxied by a failure to claim over ten years after a legal requirement to do so. Analysis of state unclaimed property databases suggests that workplace defined contribution plans are abandoned at a higher rate than IRAs. Finally, regression discontinuity estimates show that certain accounts created by default enrollment are at higher risk of abandonment by passive savers.
articles.abstract_cn: 退休储蓄被弃置是一个日益受到关注的问题，与固定缴款制度和默认注册相关。我们利用个人退休账户（IRAs）的税收数据来确定，对于最近的一个队列，0.4%的退休年龄个体放弃了总计$66百万的资产，以在法律要求领取后十年内未能申领作为代理指标。对各州无人认领财产数据库的分析表明，工作场所固定缴款计划被弃置的比率高于个人退休账户。最后，断点回归估计显示，某些通过默认注册创建的账户被被动储蓄者弃置的风险更高。

articles.title_en: Barking up the wrong tree: Return-chasing in 401(k) plans
articles.title_cn: 找错了对象：401(k)计划中的收益追逐
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines investors’ retirement savings allocation using a hand-collected dataset on 401(k) plans. We find that 83% of investors in our sample hold only 39% of total assets and follow a return-chasing strategy. In contrast, the remaining 17% of wealthy investors with relatively higher financial literacy follow CAPM alpha. This difference between the two investor groups explains why fund flows respond to returns at the plan level but to CAPM alpha at the aggregated fund level. Return-chasing by unwealthy investors is not optimal, as it significantly underperforms a strategy that passively invests in the existing funds in their plans.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用手工收集的401(k)计划数据集，考察投资者的退休储蓄配置。我们发现，样本中83%的投资者仅持有总资产的39%，并遵循收益追逐策略。相比之下，其余17%具有相对较高金融素养的富裕投资者则遵循CAPM alpha。这两类投资者之间的差异解释了为何基金流量在计划层面响应收益，而在基金汇总层面响应CAPM alpha。非富裕投资者的收益追逐并非最优，因为其表现显著逊于被动投资于其计划中现有基金的策略。
